verdicts.line: You roar, and everyone who witnesses it is frightened — whatever you intend.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Direct lift from §2.5 tutorial narration, preserving the exact mechanical consequence and the 'whatever you intend' paradox that defines the verb.

verdicts.line: Roar. All who witness it are frightened, regardless of what you feel.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Imperative register matches tutorial style, 'regardless of what you feel' preserves the flame-independence mechanic from the chunk.

verdicts.line: The roar frightens everyone who hears it. Your intention does not matter.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line take an unconditional Fear push
verdicts.reason: Chunks specify 'witness' not 'hears' — roar is witnessed along a line, not heard as sound.
verdicts.correction: The roar frightens everyone who witnesses it. Your intention does not matter.

verdicts.line: You roar. Everyone in its path becomes afraid — even if you burn with hope.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: NPCs within witness radius R (~6 tiles) of the line
verdicts.reason: Roar affects witnesses 'of the line' not 'in its path' — NPCs near the line are affected, not NPCs struck by it.
verdicts.correction: You roar. Everyone who witnesses it becomes afraid — even if you burn with hope.

verdicts.line: Roar, and all who witness are made fearful. The flame's color changes nothing.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Preserves witness-based trigger and flame-independence; 'The flame's color changes nothing' is a valid restatement of 'unconditional Fear push regardless of flame color'.

verdicts.line: The roar is fear itself. Everyone who hears it cowers, whatever color you carry.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: The narration is instrumentation, not lore — short declarative lines, no mythology
verdicts.reason: 'The roar is fear itself' is mythological metaphor where instrumentation is required; 'cowers' is flavor not mechanical consequence.
verdicts.correction: The roar frightens all who witness it. Whatever color you carry changes nothing.

verdicts.line: You roar. The earth shatters ahead, and everyone who sees it is frightened — no matter your flame.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: you roar and the earth shatters ahead
verdicts.reason: Combines the tutorial's terrain effect with witness-based fear and flame-independence — all three mechanical consequences in one declarative line.

verdicts.line: Roar: it frightens all witnesses. What you intend makes no difference.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the roar frightens all who witness it, whatever you intend
verdicts.reason: Imperative form, witness trigger, and 'What you intend makes no difference' preserves the intentionality paradox from the chunk.
